Fixtures for the Al-Jamharah dictionary parser. The markup of `word-196*.html` is the
`<main>` element of https://islamic-content.com/dictionary/word/196 and /196/en as served on
2026-10-05 (scripts/styles removed). `dictionary.html` and `term-1063.html` keep the live
page structure (`.post-title a` cards and the featured «اخترنا لك» link) with only a few items.
